facts.value: Reads shared has_z_scale and dispatches all four unchanged arguments to the base callback or rigid/shared/envelope helper. vmtx is a view transform; pmtx is the prepared current-joint position matrix consumed by GX position loads, not a camera projection matrix. Skin dispatch tests the secondary union JObj pointer; unknown types under active correction perform no setup.

evidence.why: Flagfalse delegates base. Flagtrue dispatches skin NULLsecondary to rigid, nonNULL to shared, shape to rigid, envelope to palette. Unknown type does nothing. pmtx is prepared position matrix, not camera projection.

facts.value: If val equals current idx, does nothing. Otherwise writes idx, sets x221D_b2=true, then invokes the guarded hide helper only for channel0. This is a sequence of ordinary writes and a call, with no atomicity guarantee; other channel latches are not invalidated.

evidence.why: On changed idx only, stores value, dirtytrue and calls hide channel0; other channels stay untouched. No atomicity/concurrency guarantee.

facts.value: When lookup exists and cleared[idx] is false, clears flag1 on every referenced DObj and sets the latch true. A true latch skips traversal even if it came from selected-only application and alternative groups remain hidden; the latch does not prove all-visible state.
facts.rationale: The shared latch records processed state, not an all-visible invariant.

evidence.why: Requires nonNULLlookup and false latch, clears flag1 from every referenced DObj and sets latchtrue even zero models. True latch may mean selected-only application, so show-all can skip while alternatives remain hidden.

facts.value: When lookup exists and cleared[idx] is true, hides every referenced DObj by setting flag1 and clears the latch. The starting true state may represent show-all or selected-only application. NULLlookup or false latch is a no-op.
facts.rationale: Do not equate true latch with temporarily all-visible state.

evidence.why: Requires nonNULLlookup and true latch, sets flag1 for every referenced DObj then latchfalse even zero models. False latch skips hiding. Latch is shared with selected-only and show-all operations.

Active modes require nonNULLroot/new despite guarded old-link reads. No dirty/reference bookkeeping or detached-node validation.
facts.rationale: Record incomplete parent repairs, unchecked roots and exact pointer mutations.

facts.value: Selects one descriptor (root if x3==0xFF, otherwise after x3 traversal steps), copies it with child/next=NULL and loads it twice using ftParts_8007482C. That class suppresses attached DObj loading through its local load override. Inserts the nodes at configured primary/secondary anchors, then registers the primary using a fresh dobj_index=0, assigns the secondary and flags_b2. No allocation check or rollback is present; this call does not append using the fighter-wide count.
facts.rationale: Separate interpolation-node attachment from generic model/DObj append.

evidence.why: Selects root for x3FF or advances x3 descriptor steps; copies descriptor and strips next/child; loads two independent interpolation nodes; inserts into primary/secondary anchors, registers destination with local DObj index0, depth+1 only modes0/1, marks b2. No rollback/allocation guards.

facts.value: Installs ftIntpJObj as default, calls HSD_JObjLoadJoint, then clears the default toNULL and returns the result. It does not save or restore an earlier custom default. Explicit descriptor-class resolution and loader failure behavior are delegated to HSD.
facts.rationale: Clarify global override replacement and delegation limits.

evidence.why: Sets default ftIntpJObj, loads descriptor hierarchy, clears default toNULL and returns root. Does not restore preceding override. Explicit descriptor-class resolution behavior remains delegated.

facts.value: Collects DObjs in traversal order from the supplied JObj, beginning at destination index0, and converts nonNULLmaterials to ftMObj. Asserts before index32 writes; leaves dst->count unchanged and ignores fighter_obj. Traversal follows siblings and ascends existing parents, so a supplied node with a parent is not an enforced subtree boundary.

evidence.why: Depth-first traversal excludes instance children, collects DObjs from index0 with32limit and changes materials. Can ascend beyond supplied node if it has a parent. Does not write list count; arg0unused.

facts.value: void ftPartSetRotY(Fighter* fp, int part_idx, f32 rotate_y). part_idx directly indexes Fighter.parts and is a per-kind joint slot, not automatically a logical Fighter_Part identifier. rotate_y is forwarded unchanged to the selected Yrotation setter.
facts.rationale: Avoid conflating logical parts with remapped array slots.

evidence.why: Primary unless quaternion flag then alternate; assert if alternate quaternion; passes Yangle to selected setter; logical bone remap not performed.
